requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement mixes a functional capability (switching ability) with a quality attribute (filtering capability). Per Pohl §25.2, this is decomposed into a functional requirement defining the routing switch's ability to manage traffic types, and a quality requirement defining the specific filtering behavior.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.condition: when routing a network traffic flow

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switch shall switch the ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional capability of switching traffic filtering ability.

source_fragments: filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

fields.measurable_criterion: distinguish between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switch shall be capable of filtering network traffic to distinguish between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality attribute regarding the specific filtering behavior and traffic types.
